destination_content_review_metadata_chk.name: destination_content_review_metadata_chk
destination_content_review_metadata_chk.value: ("destination_content"."reviewed_at" is null and "destination_content"."reviewed_by" is null) or ("destination_content"."reviewed_at" is not null and "destination_content"."reviewed_by" is not null)

destination_ingestion_quarantine_resolut.name: destination_ingestion_quarantine_resolution_chk
destination_ingestion_quarantine_resolut.value: ("destination_ingestion_quarantine"."status" = 'resolved' and "destination_ingestion_quarantine"."resolved_at" is not null) or ("destination_ingestion_quarantine"."status" <> 'resolved' and "destination_ingestion_quarantine"."resolved_at" is null)

itinerary_days_title_length_chk.name: itinerary_days_title_length_chk
itinerary_days_title_length_chk.value: "itinerary_days"."title" is null or char_length("itinerary_days"."title") between 1 and 200

itinerary_generation_attempts_tokens_non.name: itinerary_generation_attempts_tokens_nonnegative_chk
itinerary_generation_attempts_tokens_non.value: ("itinerary_generation_attempts"."input_tokens" is null or "itinerary_generation_attempts"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("itinerary_generation_attempts"."output_tokens" is null or "itinerary_generation_attempts"."output_tokens" >= 0) and ("itinerary_generation_attempts"."total_tokens" is null or "itinerary_generation_attempts"."total_tokens" >= 0)

sources_title_length_chk.name: sources_title_length_chk
sources_title_length_chk.value: "sources"."title" is null or char_length("sources"."title") between 1 and 300

sources_license_url_length_chk.name: sources_license_url_length_chk
sources_license_url_length_chk.value: "sources"."license_url" is null or char_length("sources"."license_url") between 1 and 2048

sources_validity_order_chk.name: sources_validity_order_chk
sources_validity_order_chk.value: "sources"."valid_from" is null or "sources"."valid_until" is null or "sources"."valid_until" > "sources"."valid_from"

trip_destinations_time_order_chk.name: trip_destinations_time_order_chk
trip_destinations_time_order_chk.value: "trip_destinations"."arrival_at" is null or "trip_destinations"."departure_at" is null or "trip_destinations"."departure_at" > "trip_destinations"."arrival_at"
